headline: AnyPS5 Rebuilds Console Code for Open Platforms
lede: AnyPS5 translates PlayStation 5 executables into native Linux and Windows formats instead of enclosing them in an emulator. Its relinker, PRX implementations, and SPIR-V shader recompiler turn platform compatibility into a hard systems problem—and a preservation tool.

headline: Diagram Design Gives AI a Better Visual Grammar
lede: Diagram Design brings 29 polished HTML and SVG templates into coding environments built for AI-assisted work. It maps a project’s brand tokens onto accessible, dependency-free visuals, turning Mermaid and draw.io source into diagrams that look deliberate rather than generic.

headline: REA Turns Binary Analysis Into an Agent Workflow
lede: REA connects coding agents and terminal workflows to the tools of reverse engineering, from Ghidra and Hopper to Binwalk and JADX. Each investigation returns evidence, relationships, limitations, and unknowns—giving automated analysis a traceable working surface.

headline: Engineering Discipline Becomes an Agent Skill
lede: This collection equips coding agents with composable practices for TDD, domain modeling, and requirements alignment. Its user-invoked commands keep orchestration visible and editable, giving fast-moving AI development a more deliberate engineering loop.

headline: Claude-Mem Gives Coding Agents a Longer Memory
lede: Claude-Mem captures session activity, summarizes useful observations, and retrieves project history when the next conversation begins. SQLite storage, hybrid search, citations, and privacy exclusions make continuity practical without surrendering control of the project context.

headline: RAD Debugger Attacks Native Development Bottlenecks
lede: Epic Games’ RAD Debugger pairs a native Windows debugger with a fast linker and a purpose-built representation for debug information. The result targets the slow, unwieldy parts of large C and C++ builds, where linking and symbol handling can dominate the workday.

headline: Anthropic Packages Claude for the Working World
lede: These file-based plugins turn Claude into role-specific assistants for legal, finance, product, research, and operations teams. Markdown, JSON, slash commands, and MCP connectors provide a lightweight control plane for bringing company processes and tools into the agent loop.

headline: ArtCraft Builds a Studio Around Generative Media
lede: ArtCraft treats AI generation as a scene-building process rather than a single prompt. Its canvas, 3D staging, compositing, posing, and multi-model workflow let creators block out an idea, revise it visually, and carry it across image, video, audio, and mesh production.

headline: System Design Notes Makes Architecture Study Portable
lede: This study archive distills load balancing, caching, sharding, queues, and other system-design patterns into structured Markdown and diagrams. It gives interview candidates a compact reference for revisiting trade-offs without reopening an entire textbook.
